WCC USI Monday Night Ride

White Plains, NY · Road

WCC USI Monday Night Ride is a road group ride in White Plains, NY. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Waller Ave. parking lot. About 16–32 miles, b, ~16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the WCC USI Monday Night Ride group ride

A B-pace Monday evening ride from the Waller Avenue lot in White Plains, with a shorter and a longer option. Westchester Cycle Club also runs faster Tuesday and Thursday training rides from the same lot at 5:15 pm.
